families.overview: GE's lighting/appliance panelboard platform. Symmetrical 20 in wide x 5.81 in deep galvanized boxes with removable endwalls, branch-bus direct connection and captive branch hardware. Type letter indicates breaker family: AL = plug-in Q-line, AQ = bolt-on Q-line (THQB), AE = bolt-on E-frame (TEY) 480Y/277 V, AD = 600 V TED/SE/FB. Pro-Stock unassembled interiors (AQU/AEU) are completed with MB main breaker kits, ML main lug kits and NK neutral kits. Pages in the 2014 BuyLog are headed 'A-Series II' on the column-panel kit page.

families.overview: GE's power distribution panelboard. Two interior styles: APN plug-in (breakers bolt to AMC circuit breaker mounting modules that latch onto the interior rail and clip onto the bus; ADS fusible switch modules) and APNB bolt-on (breakers bolt to copper straps AMCB kits fastened with carriage bolts/antiturn clips to the vertical bus). Vertical space measured in X units (1X = 1-3/8 in). Box widths 27/31/36/40/44 in, APB boxes and APF fronts, AML main-lug modules, ANK/ANKN neutral kits, AEG ground kits. NOTE on 'APN': in GE nomenclature APN is the Spectra plug-in interior type code (APNB = bolt-on), while APN48/APN84/APN126 (A-Series) and APN49/APN99 (Spectra) are permanent circuit-number tab kits; no 'A-Series power panel' code APN was found.

apn_meaning.value: APN = Panelboard Interior Type (plug-in); APNB = Panelboard Interior Type bolt-on; structure APN<X-height><amps>U[B4]

plug_in_vs_bolt_on.value: Main lug kits bolt directly to interior bus bars (either APN Plug-In Style or APNB Bolt-On Style)

log: Searched web for GE A-Series/Spectra renewal parts. Key find: full GE BuyLog Section 11 Panelboards (Rev 11/13, updated 07/2014) mirrored by USESI (ABB original host blocked: HTTP/2 INTERNAL_ERROR, 503). Extracted A-Series Pro-Stock MB main breaker kits, ML/NK lug & neutral kits, filler plates TQLFP1/TEDFP1, ASP breaker mounting kits, accessories; Spectra AMC plug-in module tables (3P/2P), AMCB bolt-on strap kits, AFP/APP fillers, AHK hardware, AML lug modules, ANKN/ANK neutrals, AEG grounds, AFL feed-thru kits, SCP+ ACTMK kits, CCB/QMR DPK/SPK strap kits and filler plates; publications list (GEH-56xx, DEH-04x/06x). Downloaded A-Series II power-panel breaker kit instructions DEH40150-DEH40158 (Carbon Controls mirror; yodify mirror links are dead) giving full parts lists with GE drawing numbers and torques. Read Spectra DEH065 (AMCB4QD/6QD), GEH5674 (AMC2GM/3GM), DEH40392 (AMCB6TEDL), DEH212 (AEG47) via manualsdir text rendering. manualmachine.com blocked (403). APN investigation: 'APN' in GE nomenclature = Spectra plug-in panelboard interior type (APNB = bolt-on), per BuyLog p.11-37/11-28/11-47; APN48/APN84/APN126 (+AD suffix) = A-Series permanent circuit number kits; APN49/APN99 = Spectra permanent circuit number tabs. A-Series power panels are AQP/AEP/ADP, not APN. Not found: OEM docs for NLAB/NHB/CCB-era legacy panels, CDP, AV-Line, ReliaGear LV; ReliaGear neXT kit catalog number. Footnote digits fused to catalog numbers in the PDF text were stripped (e.g. 'MB23325' -> MB2332 with footnote 5, 'AMC6FJFP1' -> AMC6FJFP) and noted in claims. AMC/AMCB base numbers without 'FP' recorded as alias (conf B, from nomenclature). DEH44151 (TNK400 neutral kit for safety switches) seen but out of scope.
